mechanics.summary: Pit Mine on an unclaimed gold deposit generates gold passively without depleting it; each House or Mining Camp in its influence adds +25% of the base rate. Villagers can still mine the same deposit. If the deposit is exhausted the Pit Mine keeps extracting (and can be re-placed on exhausted veins).

params.whenDepleted: continues extracting; can be re-placed on exhausted veins
